QF.id: SIA Social Stock Exchange Introduction and Instruments_21

question.text: The listing of a Zero Coupon Zero Principal Instrument on the SSE will TERMINATE when which of the following conditions is met?

answer.text: The issuing NPO surrenders its Section 12A registration.
The NPO's audited accounts show the program cost exceeded the ZCZP subscription amount by more than 10%.
The Social Impact Fund subscriber redeems its units.

The object for which the funds were raised has been achieved AND a certificate to this effect is submitted to the SSE; OR the tenure to achieve the object as provided in the fund-raising document has expired.

explanation.text: The Logic: Per p.70 of the workbook, ZCZP listing terminates if (a) the object for which funds were raised has been achieved and a certificate to this effect is submitted to the SSE, OR (b) the tenure to achieve the object as provided in the fund-raising document has expired. These are the two statutory triggers. The Trap: Option A is irrelevant to listing termination. Option B invents a cost-overrun trigger that does not exist. Option C is irrelevant because Social Impact Fund redemption does not end the listing of the underlying ZCZP. Note: Stick to the two p.70 termination triggers (object achieved + certificate, or tenure expiry) when verifying ZCZP delisting.
